meta.name: market-entry
meta.description: Decides whether and how to enter a new market — sizing demand from the bottom up rather than from a market report, testing whether your advantage transfers, choosing between organic entry, partnership and acquisition, sequencing the operational and regulatory work that entry actually requires, and setting the criteria that would tell you to stop. Use this to evaluate a new geography, segment or vertical, pressure-test an entry plan, or work out why a launched market never reached scale.

copy.tagline: 判断该不该进新市场,并规划进入路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正打算进入新地区或新行业,想先验证机会再投入。
copy.tagline_en: Assess a new market opportunity and plan your entry strategy.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你自下而上估算市场规模,检验你的优势能否迁移到新市场,在有机增长、合作与收购之间选择进入方式,梳理运营与合规成本,并设定明确的停止条件。
howto.when: 当你评估新地理市场、细分客户或新行业,需压力测试进入计划,或分析已进入市场为何未达规模时触发。

say.text: 我该不该进入东南亚市场?
say.note: Claude 会引导你自下而上估算需求。

say.text: 帮我压力测试一下我们的德国扩张计划。
say.note: Claude 会检查优势迁移与成本估计。

say.text: 为什么我们的日本市场一直做不大?
say.note: Claude 会按停止条件复盘原因。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will guide you to size the market bottom-up, test whether your advantage transfers, choose among organic, partnership or acquisition, scope operating and regulatory costs, and set stopping criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you evaluate a new geography, segment, or vertical, pressure-test an entry plan, or analyse why a launched market never scaled.

say_en.note: Claude will guide your bottom-up demand sizing.

say_en.text: Help us pressure-test our Germany expansion plan.
say_en.note: Claude will check advantage transfer and cost realism.

say_en.text: Why has our Japan market never scaled?
say_en.note: Claude will review against your stopping criteria.
